sourceFirstChallenge.test: The first option retains six literary courses,five communication courses,psycholinguistics and cultural/media inquiry. The second retains rhetoric,stylistics,psycholinguistics,persuasion,creative communication,literary interpretation and media alongside specific cognitive and research methods. Its language inquiry is real,although less literary. The current course content does not support Dutch/Flemish corpus or historical phonology/syntax claims.
sourceFirstChallenge.resolution: Approve only broader disciplinary alternatives with these omissions central in description and scope. The repeated module cannot be counted twice. A credible replacement in either principal strand strengthens a named specialist gap but does not eliminate the actual literary/language inquiry. No matching quota or new national-corpus equivalence test is imposed.
